newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's ATX bolts higher, breaks resistance.
newsitem.headline: Austria's ATX bolts higher, breaks resistance.

text.p: 0749 GMT - Austria's blue-chip ATX index storms higher at the open and breaks through resistance at 1,310 points, with buying encouraged by firm sentiment and dollar, traders said.
* ATX index up 1.06 pct at 1,323.61 points.
* 18 ATX shares higher, two lower, one unchanged
* Leading ATX gainer Wolford, up 4.42 pct at 1,242.65 ats.
* Top ATX loser Leykam, down 0.15 pct at 305 ats.
* July ATX future up 23 points at 1,330. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12274
